description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayChannelActor class, specifically testing websocket connection behaviors, handling of authentication failures, and concurrent connection management within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: GatewayChannelConnectTests
classes.description: A set of async unit tests for GatewayChannelActor's websocket connection logic, including handling of success, failure, and authentication error scenarios.

methods.name: `concurrent connect is single flight on success`
methods.description: Tests that concurrent connection attempts when successful do not cause multiple connection initiations.

methods.name: `concurrent connect shares failure`
methods.description: Tests that concurrent connection attempts when failing share the failure result and do not cause multiple connection attempts.

methods.name: `connect surfaces structured auth failure`
methods.description: Verifies that authentication failures during connection are properly surfaced as GatewayConnectAuthError with all relevant details.
